subject: Workplace Skills
title: Research Before You Ask
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Research Before You Ask.

hook.text: She asked for a 40% raise without data. Her manager laughed. She asked again with market research. She got 20%.

buildup.text: Negotiation without data is guessing. Data gives you credibility and anchors the conversation to facts.

discovery.text: Use salary sites, industry reports, and peer conversations to find your market range before any negotiation.

twist.text: Companies know your market value better than you do. Research levels the information gap in your favor.

climax.text: Frame your ask with data: 'Market rate for this role in our region is X to Y. I believe Z reflects my impact.'

punchline.text: Data wins negotiations. Research before you ask.

quiz.question: Why is market research crucial before salary negotiations?
options: It proves you spent time preparing
It levels the information gap and anchors the conversation to facts
Employers only respond to data from specific websites
